# WebMCP Sheets — Full Machine-Readable Specification

> Complete technical reference, JSON Schemas, formula signatures, and autonomous agent protocol documentation for WebMCP Sheets.

- Root Endpoint: https://mauricioperera.github.io/webmcp-sheets/
- Short Specification: https://mauricioperera.github.io/webmcp-sheets/llms.txt
- Full Specification: https://mauricioperera.github.io/webmcp-sheets/llms-full.txt
- Repository: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/webmcp-sheets

---

## 1. System Architecture

### WebMCP safety extension

The runtime exposes 21 tools through one validated dispatcher. Range calls are capped at 10,000 cells, matrices at 100 by 100, text at 10,000 characters, and exports at 1 MB. Destructive requests create a 60-second preview operation and require `sheets_confirm_operation` plus a visible browser confirmation.

WebMCP Sheets operates 100% in the client's browser without requiring backend servers.
- **State Store**: Reactive in-memory store (`CellStore`) managing multiple worksheet tabs.
- **Calculation Engine**: Custom lexical tokenizer and Shunting-Yard AST evaluator supporting 30+ functions.
- **Dependency Graph**: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with Tarjan cycle detection; circular chains immediately evaluate to `#CYCLE!`.
- **UI & Presentation**: Tailwind CSS with HTMX reactivity for formula bars, cell selection, grid headers, and agent activity drawer.
- **Agent Interop**: FastWebMCP server registered in window / navigator scope, enabling zero-latency tool calls via browser agents or devtools evaluation.

---

## 2. WebMCP Tools Full JSON Schemas

### `sheets_get_cell`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_get_cell",
  "description": "Get raw value, computed value and format of a specific cell (e.g. A1, B5).",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "cell": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Cell coordinate reference, e.g. \"A1\" or \"Sheet1!B2\""
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      }
    },
    "required": ["cell"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "cell": { "type": "string" },
      "sheet": { "type": "string" },
      "raw": { "type": "string" },
      "value": { "type": ["string", "number", "boolean"] },
      "error": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
      "format": { "type": "object" }
    },
    "required": ["cell", "sheet", "raw", "value"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_set_cell`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_set_cell",
  "description": "Set raw value or formula for a cell, with optional formatting.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "cell": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Cell coordinate reference, e.g. \"A1\""
      },
      "value": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Value or formula starting with \"=\""
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      },
      "format": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "bold": { "type": "boolean" },
          "italic": { "type": "boolean" },
          "textColor": { "type": "string" },
          "bgColor": { "type": "string" },
          "align": { "type": "string", "enum": ["left", "center", "right"] },
          "numberFormat": { "type": "string", "enum": ["text", "number", "currency", "percent"] }
        }
      }
    },
    "required": ["cell", "value"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "success": { "type": "boolean" },
      "cell": { "type": "string" },
      "value": { "type": ["string", "number", "boolean", "null"] }
    },
    "required": ["success", "cell"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_get_range`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_get_range",
  "description": "Get values and formulas for a rectangular range of cells (e.g. \"A1:C5\").",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "range": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Range reference, e.g. \"A1:B10\""
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      }
    },
    "required": ["range"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "range": { "type": "string" },
      "sheet": { "type": "string" },
      "matrix": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "ref": { "type": "string" },
              "raw": { "type": "string" },
              "value": { "type": ["string", "number", "boolean", "null"] }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "required": ["range", "sheet", "matrix"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_set_range`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_set_range",
  "description": "Batch set a 2D matrix of values or formulas into a range starting at given coordinate.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "startCell": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Top-left cell coordinate, e.g. \"A1\""
      },
      "values": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string" }
        },
        "description": "2D array of strings representing rows and columns"
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      }
    },
    "required": ["startCell", "values"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "success": { "type": "boolean" },
      "rowsUpdated": { "type": "number" }
    },
    "required": ["success", "rowsUpdated"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_evaluate_formula`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_evaluate_formula",
  "description": "Evaluate an arbitrary formula expression on the fly (e.g. \"=SUM(10, 20, 30)\").",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "formula": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Formula expression starting with \"=\""
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet context"
      }
    },
    "required": ["formula"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "formula": { "type": "string" },
      "result": { "type": ["string", "number", "boolean", "null"] },
      "error": { "type": ["string", "null"] }
    },
    "required": ["formula"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_clear_range`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_clear_range",
  "description": "Clear values and formatting in a specified rectangular range.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "range": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Range reference, e.g. \"A1:C10\""
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      }
    },
    "required": ["range"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "success": { "type": "boolean" },
      "clearedRange": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "required": ["success", "clearedRange"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_create_sheet`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_create_sheet",
  "description": "Add a new sheet tab to the workbook with the given name.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "name": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Name for the new sheet"
      }
    },
    "required": ["name"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "success": { "type": "boolean" },
      "sheetId": { "type": "string" },
      "name": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "required": ["success", "sheetId", "name"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_delete_sheet`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_delete_sheet",
  "description": "Delete a sheet tab from the workbook by name.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "name": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Name of the sheet to delete"
      }
    },
    "required": ["name"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "success": { "type": "boolean" },
      "deleted": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "required": ["success", "deleted"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_list_sheets`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_list_sheets",
  "description": "List all sheets in the current workbook and report the active sheet.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {}
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "activeSheet": { "type": "string" },
      "sheets": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "id": { "type": "string" },
            "name": { "type": "string" },
            "cellCount": { "type": "number" }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "required": ["activeSheet", "sheets"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_find_replace`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_find_replace",
  "description": "Find and replace text or formula substrings across cells.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "find": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "String to search for"
      },
      "replace": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Replacement string"
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      },
      "matchCase": {
        "type": "boolean",
        "description": "Match case sensitive (default false)"
      }
    },
    "required": ["find", "replace"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "success": { "type": "boolean" },
      "replacementsCount": { "type": "number" }
    },
    "required": ["success", "replacementsCount"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_export_data`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_export_data",
  "description": "Export spreadsheet data in CSV or JSON format.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "format": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": ["csv", "json"],
        "description": "Export format"
      },
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name for CSV export"
      }
    },
    "required": ["format"]
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "format": { "type": "string" },
      "data": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "required": ["format", "data"]
  }
}
```

### `sheets_get_summary`
```json
{
  "name": "sheets_get_summary",
  "description": "Get an analytical summary of non-empty cells, columns, and numeric totals.",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "sheet": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Optional sheet name"
      }
    }
  },
  "response": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "title": { "type": "string" },
      "sheet": { "type": "string" },
      "populatedCells": { "type": "number" },
      "numericCellsCount": { "type": "number" },
      "sumOfNumericCells": { "type": "number" },
      "averageOfNumericCells": { "type": "number" }
    },
    "required": ["title", "sheet", "populatedCells", "numericCellsCount", "sumOfNumericCells", "averageOfNumericCells"]
  }
}
```

---

## 3. Function Signatures & Semantics

| Category | Function | Signature | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Math** | `SUM` | `SUM(...args)` | Adds all numerical values or range cells |
| **Math** | `AVERAGE` | `AVERAGE(...args)` | Arithmetic mean; returns `#DIV/0!` if empty |
| **Math** | `MIN` | `MIN(...args)` | Minimum numerical value |
| **Math** | `MAX` | `MAX(...args)` | Maximum numerical value |
| **Math** | `COUNT` | `COUNT(...args)` | Number of numeric elements |
| **Math** | `COUNTA` | `COUNTA(...args)` | Number of non-empty elements |
| **Math** | `COUNTBLANK` | `COUNTBLANK(...args)` | Number of empty or blank elements |
| **Math** | `PRODUCT` | `PRODUCT(...args)` | Multiplies all numerical values |
| **Math** | `ABS` | `ABS(number)` | Absolute magnitude of a number |
| **Math** | `ROUND` | `ROUND(number, [digits])` | Rounds to specified decimal places |
| **Math** | `ROUNDUP` | `ROUNDUP(number, [digits])` | Ceilings to specified decimal places |
| **Math** | `ROUNDDOWN` | `ROUNDDOWN(number, [digits])` | Floors to specified decimal places |
| **Math** | `MOD` | `MOD(dividend, divisor)` | Modulo remainder; returns `#DIV/0!` if divisor is 0 |
| **Math** | `POWER` | `POWER(base, exponent)` | Computes base raised to power exponent |
| **Math** | `SQRT` | `SQRT(number)` | Square root; returns `#NUM!` if negative |
| **Math** | `INT` | `INT(number)` | Truncates downwards to nearest integer |
| **Math** | `MEDIAN` | `MEDIAN(...args)` | Computes median value of numbers |
| **Logic** | `IF` | `IF(test, true_val, [false_val])` | Branching condition |
| **Logic** | `IFS` | `IFS(c1, v1, c2, v2, ...)` | Sequential multi-condition check |
| **Logic** | `AND` | `AND(...args)` | Logical conjunction (true if all truthy) |
| **Logic** | `OR` | `OR(...args)` | Logical disjunction (true if any truthy) |
| **Logic** | `NOT` | `NOT(val)` | Inverts boolean truthiness |
| **Logic** | `ISBLANK` | `ISBLANK(val)` | True if cell or value is empty |
| **Logic** | `ISNUMBER` | `ISNUMBER(val)` | True if value is numeric |
| **Logic** | `ISTEXT` | `ISTEXT(val)` | True if value is string |
| **Text** | `CONCAT` | `CONCAT(...args)` | String concatenation |
| **Text** | `CONCATENATE`| `CONCATENATE(...args)` | Alias to CONCAT |
| **Text** | `TEXTJOIN` | `TEXTJOIN(delim, ignore_empty, ...args)` | Joins strings with delimiter |
| **Text** | `UPPER` | `UPPER(text)` | Converts text to uppercase |
| **Text** | `LOWER` | `LOWER(text)` | Converts text to lowercase |
| **Text** | `PROPER` | `PROPER(text)` | Title cases first letter of each word |
| **Text** | `TRIM` | `TRIM(text)` | Strips leading/trailing/extra spaces |
| **Text** | `LEN` | `LEN(text)` | Character count of string |
| **Text** | `LEFT` | `LEFT(text, [count])` | Substring from left |
| **Text** | `RIGHT` | `RIGHT(text, [count])` | Substring from right |
| **Text** | `MID` | `MID(text, start, length)` | Substring starting at 1-based index |
| **Lookup**| `VLOOKUP` | `VLOOKUP(val, range, col, [isExact])` | Vertical table lookup |
| **Lookup**| `INDEX` | `INDEX(range, row, col)` | Returns value at row and column offsets |
| **Lookup**| `MATCH` | `MATCH(val, range)` | 1-based offset index of lookup value |
| **Date** | `TODAY` | `TODAY()` | Returns current date in `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| **Date** | `NOW` | `NOW()` | Returns current ISO-8601 timestamp |
| **Date** | `YEAR` | `YEAR(date)` | Extracts 4-digit year |
| **Date** | `MONTH` | `MONTH(date)` | Extracts month (1-12) |
| **Date** | `DAY` | `DAY(date)` | Extracts day of month (1-31) |

---

## 4. End-to-End Orchestration Example

```javascript
// Step 1: Initialize model
await window.WebMCP.execute('sheets_set_range', {
  startCell: 'A1',
  values: [
    ['Country', 'GDP_2023', 'Growth_Rate', 'GDP_2024'],
    ['USA', '27360', '0.025', '=B2*(1+C2)'],
    ['China', '17790', '0.052', '=B3*(1+C3)'],
    ['Germany', '4456', '0.003', '=B4*(1+C4)'],
    ['Japan', '4212', '0.010', '=B5*(1+C5)'],
    ['Total', '=SUM(B2:B5)', '', '=SUM(D2:D5)']
  ]
});

// Step 2: Format cells
await window.WebMCP.execute('sheets_set_cell', {
  cell: 'D6',
  value: '=SUM(D2:D5)',
  format: { bold: true, numberFormat: 'currency' }
});

// Step 3: Validate outputs
const total2024 = await window.WebMCP.execute('sheets_get_cell', { cell: 'D6' });
console.log('Projected 2024 GDP Total:', total2024.value);
```
